rules: all observed same-name correlation enqueues and dequeues in full DB must each be unique and each row resolve to one correlation; target boundary is target enqueue end; interval times clipped
limits: Profiler I/O error, dropped events, ID reuse outside captured DB cannot be excluded.
Enqueue start/end vs target does not establish FIFO, causality, critical path or that same physical queue serviced all operations.
An unrecorded enqueue/dequeue invalidates uniqueness assumptions.
The DB contains profiler overhead, cannot establish online scheduling latency.
